review_notes: I read the whole target file. I also read its imported CompactWordCost.lean and CompactGeneratingBalls.lean. I looked for Mathlib counterparts to the main constructions in the target. These were `weightedGroupMetric` (a MetricSpace built from a GroupNorm with `MetricSpace.ofDistTopology`), `metricGroupNorm` (dist 1 g as a GroupNorm), `weightedGroupMetric_isometric`, `weightedGroupMetric_proper` and `isCompact_set_pow`. A grep of Mathlib found no left-invariant metric built from a GroupNorm on a noncommutative group. It also found no `IsCompact.pow`; only `IsCompact.mul` exists, and `isCompact_set_pow` is built from it. The Group.Generators word-length API from Mathlib is reused rather than duplicated. The ad hoc `compactWordCost` and `compactWeightedNorm` are specific to this construction and have no Mathlib equivalent. I found no independent competing version of an existing Mathlib concept, so I report nothing.
